reviews.text: 100%工资的雇员只是工具，但是10%工资的雇员，那就是我的家人呐！ —————————————————————————————————— 玩了5个小时后发现，当解锁了alt撞退小怪后，窃贼就变成抢劫犯了，找个墙角把怪引过来壁咚撞晕，然后上去就抢，如果良心泯灭 抢完还可以扔个炸弹娃娃 哥布林真是毫无人性（不是 ——————————————————————34小时贪婪难度通关，烧树结局条件符合，但是选的通吃。 看很多人说哥布林弱，我怀疑主要问题出在了没带骨头上。这游戏最难得几个地方如下。 1.初见飞眼球，没有反制手段，实际在火把附近的，可以引导火球炸死它，在小怪附近的直接撞晕小怪，把小怪武器偷了，眼球就只会叫了。 2.刚到黄金村，难度陡然提升。由于骨头稀有度比较高，即使贪婪难度自带100幸运，在教堂也没拿到几根。骨头前期主要产出是在教堂三祭祀身上，然而三祭祀又是第一关的关底boss，以刚打完三祭祀的进度去探黄金村很容易暴毙。实际上，去刷三四个晚上祭祀，合几根紫骨头就舒服起来了，到最后通关我带的是金色红骨头×2，金色绿骨头×2，打boss紫色也可以一起戴上，角色血量80～120，速度加80%，这小绿玩意跑起来比跟飞一样。 3.金叶银行，如果你跟我一样做了血精灵任务，这里会提前开放，否则会在遇到魔王后开放，提前开放也挺好的，就是前期强度太高，让人摸不到头脑（红激光碰一下5滴血，对前期20多血量的哥布林算是要命了，后期我一百多血在激光里洗澡冲刺）这里的箱子中物品稀有度很高，而且有几个护符很重要，比如右上角的三段跳。银行建议40血量左右再来探索，或者多带血药和一个回家茧，保证贼不走空。 3.矿底建议去网上找个地图看下，每次去矿底的小目标是去关一到两个迷雾机关，全关掉矿底你基本也探完了。矿底右上角有个降低偷反难度的护符，有了它你将成为幽灵怪的法泽尔，偷反+4键qte，偷走核心幽灵怪就嘎了 4.卖货套路还挺多，我选择的是抬价+倍率，爆点+倍率，顾客增加两组，爆点回复话术点，弓武器按最贵的一把价格结算。留好路上偷到五百块的弓，剩下的全是白板也无所谓，抬价爆抬价爆只卖给最后两个人，一单三四万是有的，但是这个肯定不是最优解 总结:神技是alt屁冲和屁冲击晕，带上冲刺距离和撞飞距离根据速度增加的护符，撞一下能把房子中间的怪直接撞飞到两边墙上。不建议点踩头会影响落地，导致屁冲冲向空气。金币虫神技是草丛，夹子和铃铛也有用。装死一次没用过，我也不知道好不好用。看破隐身是矿底必备的技能，有了它就不用带显形药水了。一万五的面具技能感觉都属于可点可不点，最终的快乐玩法就是撞晕，偷武器，包满了就扔掉，小怪就只能用拳头打你，别当小偷了，当个大劫匪吧。

搜偷撤加卖货的玩法，目前玩下来整体不错，剧情和美术都有让人继续玩下去的动力。但是冲刺能不能换一个描述和音效，屁动力还是太抽象了非常出戏，或者给一个切换音效和特效的选项。 --------------------------------------- 4.8小时追评：4小时正式进入图二，有了钩锁和冲撞之后探索便利了很多。但是图二激增的难度又导致死亡变得频繁，追债的时间和模式还存在优化空间，各种词条无法看到具体数字对于数据党来说有些难受。以上的不足不影响我期待后续的体验，希望制作组能好好打磨，加油。

支收平衡做的不太行，前期平均60%以上的收入都需要偿还欠款，还要腾出钱来升级和给自己容错。几乎每把满背包撤离才能勉强支撑游戏继续推进下去。这就导致玩家一直在非常高压的环境下游玩，赚钱赚不爽偷东西偷不爽。这种问题会随着游戏时间的拉长变得越来越严重，角色的技能、被动、店铺的升级等等费用会占用大部分收入。此时升级的支收比例几乎会占据玩家总收益的90%，也就是一波没从地牢出来就会因为交不起税收直接游戏结束。 因此完全可以取消定期的租金，改成随时支付。支付租金推进更多剧情出现，不支付的话就无法推进剧情。这样有钱就还没钱就想办法赚，不会被债务卡游戏节奏。而现在这种催债模式下很容易死档，因为还不起钱游戏直接结束，只能回到3-5天前重新积累这一次的资金。 毕竟不是肉鸽，所以重复探索相同的地下城只会随着时间越来越烦躁。如果不重复打相同地图转而更加激进的探索反而会死在路上导致经济崩溃，因为玩家承担不起经济压力。就导致玩家所有的时间几乎都要按照每日的需求去固定位置获取资源，如果不这样做那么白天几乎得不到客观的收益。如果不小心死亡那除了SL似乎没有其他更好的解决办法，这样的设计显然是不合理的。不能把SL变成常态，那玩家因为开荒失误死亡了几局就会导致经济发展落后从而陷入恶性循环，被更高的租金压得喘不过气→只能探索固定地区来获取稳定收入→没有时间开新地图。 既然想做一个融合了探索+模拟经营的游戏，那必须权衡二者在游戏机制上面的相辅相成。现在的模拟经营拖累了探索的节奏，因为能力要花钱升级而非地牢内获取。这就导致玩家在还钱之余还要花大量金钱去提升能力，这样才能探索地图。而探索也拖累了模拟经营的节奏，因为背包会限制玩家单局的成长。经常探索一半就被迫返回。一个单人游戏，背包给这么小折磨玩家完全没有任何意义。 期待后续更新以及优化，尽量选择一个侧重点，是致力于地下城的探索还是致力于店铺的经营。现在就是两头堵，探索起来公式化刷装备，经营起来赚几个破钱不够升级。

看到开发者的一些回复我真绷不住了，说说我体验的一些问题：搜偷撤，潜行，很新颖，但是想想是这样吗？我要兼顾跑酷，观察，偷窃，跑图，战斗呢还得是巅峰智斗，即使是最低最低设计的谨慎难度，也是碰两下就死，怪和陷阱大概率是一起打你的，这一切加一起这个游戏玩着比上班还累，特别是那些键位组合有的特别难受，改建也没什么改善因为他的地形设计好多就是要前期强制做那个动作组合才过的去，比如长按大跳，长按你不做动画识别的话是很容易输入识别不出来的，识别不出来你就跳不上去，长按到识别出来那个时间你已经被打死或者掉下去了，游戏还没有地图，走错了就365里了，为什么银河恶魔城类游戏都有最直接的战斗系统？是因为你不能把所有压力都给玩家，直接的战斗是一种减压的过程，设计者还说：我们不能给实时存档，低风险高收益没意义，这个回应最难绷，首先收益在那？你的收益从拿到到经营都不稳定，说了救助员工加收益，有没有考虑过没钱点技能活不到那时候呢？最终就是一遍遍的重复攒钱，好玩吗？其次你既然觉得存档，撤离什么都是低风险让游戏难度大打折扣的东西，那你设计难度选项意义在哪？最低难度也没多比高难度多能活，最终那不就是丝之歌样子的赛博坐牢吗？最后，你们说那种游戏毫无意义？有本事别卖啊，这种冒险的游戏只是玩家消遣的东西，考虑意义不是这个类型该做的，你们三个的设计只有对玩家的折磨，玩家喜欢可能只是喜欢在这个创意，细节是经不起推敲的 更新，希望JOHN（安东尼版）能看见：两个开新档发现的问题：两个问题：一个小的：开局卖东西有教学介绍，那个介绍关不掉，挡满意条和金钱信息了，一个大的，重要物品丢失不刷新，没有实时存档你们是让玩家调整到很之前的位置重新玩吗，重要物品就别整你们那自以为是的高风险了行吗

I will probably play more, since I like the core concept, but at the time of writing, there's a fair amount of bugs, typos and lack of polish here and there, so I don't feel comfortable recommending the game at the moment. I'll update the review if I do end up playing further. Devs seem to plan to add some QoL features.

The overall gameplay loop is fun and all, but as of now the game lacks some needed QoL features. -First of all, more control over sound; There is first of all the Fart Dash, which is as it sounds, a dash with a comical *PFRT* sound effect. Not something I minded at first, but gets annoying fast. You will of course dash all the time, either to quickly get around or to escape enemies, and hearing that comical sound effect while serious music in the middle of a chase happens is taking all the momentum out of such a chase. There is also a Charm which I found, which drastically increases luck, at the downside of ringing a bell every 10 seconds. This one I am mostly fine with, it's just a bell after all. But when the night ends, and you have to manage your inventory, move stuff from your backpack and employees into your shops inventory, move stuff around, flip it and all to get the best stuff in, the BELL. KEEPS. CHIMING It does take some minutes to arrange everything, even more so as it was bugged for me and didn't allow me to drag and flip some (not all) items. Listening to the Bell chiming for 3 minutes while playing at 11pm was annoying. That one was a personal gripe, the next two things feel like they were just implemented to make the game less fun, which is very weird to me. -I found annoying that the golden coinbugs, which are the main resource for your abilities which interact with enemies (distraction, smoke cloud, etc) have to be collected every night. This incentivizes to not go to your deepest checkpoint, but start further up, collect coinbugs and only then go through newer areas, which just feels like stretching out the gameplay needlessly, when you could just carry over those coinbugs between runs. -While the abilities are great for some control during the daylight haggling, I think it's very stingy to only give 3 points at the very start, which turns to 4 on the first level up. If the points would refresh between customers, sure, but encountering the first, using 3 focus on them (and maybe even still failing due to bad luck) only to then have to do the other 3 customers with just rolling, no abilities is just unfun. Definitely should refresh between customers. -The punishment on dying is unreasonable. While dying in a game like Moonlighter, in which you also manage a shop, results in you losing (most) of your loot, just as in Goblin Vyke, in Moonlighter you don't have something akin to a rent to pay. In Goblin Vyke you have a steadily rising rent payment you'll have to meet, and if you can't pay it it's game over. This results in a constant dread and prevents the player from calmly figuring out the gameplay and mechanics, which is a horrid feeling for the first couple hours, in which everything is new. It also disincentivizes you from investing into you skills and upgrades, as those get expensive fast, and the steadily rising rent is, for some weird and incomprehensible reason, due EVERY THREE DAYS. For now I'll wait on the game and hopefully some improvements will be made in time so the inherently fun Gameplay loop will actually be made fun enough so I can experience the whole Story.

如果看到我这条评论了，那么我非常不推荐入手这款游戏，除非你是闯关跑酷类游戏爱好者，这款游戏只是以类塔科夫为噱头和开局的闯关类游戏。我想要的是和越来越难偷的怪博弈去斗智斗勇再偶尔偷出几个低概率的特殊收藏品带来的爽感，而不是越来越复杂的地图和地图机制，感觉制作组完全本末倒置了，这个游戏本身的亮点偷撤模拟经营无限的被边缘化取而代之的是越来越恶心的地图，越来越复杂的地图机制，小怪永远是那三种，获得的物品也永远是升个级换个皮，硬是把本来底子非常优秀的一个游戏做成了一个无限的高难背图的跑酷闯关游戏，但凡这个游戏地图不是固定的是完全随机的，怪的种类和陷阱种类越来越多越来越复杂，开店不是永远就那么一种摇骰子砍价没成sl，没有30格的死亡背包，没有撞墙撞晕就能偷的这么强的机制，偷起来前期战战兢兢偷偷摸摸的过去偷完跑路或者想办法用陷阱把怪打死，这才是爽点，那几个诅咒娃娃就不应该做成放背包才能生效，我打通关了都没用过几次那个，就应该做成可以丢出去的，都能偷到武器了还放个道具进去看戏？制作组也是牛批，能把这么好的底子做成这么粪。如果是我来做这款游戏，我会做成类死亡细胞的形式，保留类塔科夫，偷以及模拟经营的核心形式，去掉金币虫的设定，改为局外购买制作和局内随机获取的随机道具，比如自带的可无限使用的石子，持续吸引注意的炮仗，音响，能炸敌人的雷管炸弹，方便跑路的烟雾弹，眩晕敌人但无法击杀的闪光弹，以及各种陷阱，在局内加入各种草药虫子矿石等等用于在局外和局内制作这些道具，局外的成长不仅仅有开店和拿金币换加成，各种设施的升级加入需要各种怪物的特殊材料和需要采集的各种材料，地图做成在设定的范围内随机刷新，boss和精英怪也改为随机刷新，在偷的设定下改为要去几个护卫那里偷开门钥匙或者其他特殊条件，全怪物低概率掉落各种可重复刷取可带出局外但死亡即消失的强力道具，在局内随机刷新各种各样的奇遇事件增加点惊喜感，这样不比一个披着类塔科夫皮的闯关游戏强的多，能卖爆好吧

白天的模拟经营简陋得不可思议，感觉是做恶魔城做得发狠了忘情了不知天地为何物了，有点心思全花在怎么整玩家身上了。 刚出教堂就感觉明显变了个游戏，难度曲线非常陡峭，尤其银行图放普通类银都算是有点粪的，何况你这主角攻击键还扣掉了，边跑图还边被怪追得嗷嗷叫。 主角基础性能太弱了，能直接跳上的平台极少，二段跳（包括后续的三段跳）用处极其有限，并没有说哪个地方基础跳跃上不去，会了二段跳就行了；但钩锁与肚皮冲击又太强了，导致主角有点像带着立体机动装置的霍金。 点出钩锁等便宜的基础技能后，面对一二图的敌人已经算是强度溢出了。这段时间公式跑图攒钱的心流体验还算不错。 可当后续敌人的性能也提升了一个档次（尤其是补上韧性）之后，主角的性能却被锁死无法提升，导致无力感极其强烈。 技能树再往后的偷反、装死、艾克r之流，看着挺带感，但是……使用场景呢？没感觉它们有存在的必要性啊。 当我在银行金库面对那有十个我高的大机器人，辛辛苦苦赚钱花4000金币花15000金币点出来的技能竟然一点用武之地都没有，钩锁与肚皮这两个好伙伴也变成了滚木，只能回归最原始最纯粹的卡视野推箱子拉拉杆，被各种殴打到剩下9滴血缩在下水道的阴沟里等机器人过来帮我挡住激光不然直接去世的时候，我不禁思考我当初买这个游戏是干嘛来的。 找虐么？ 顺带一提，回过头看，感觉这个游戏的最优解是……缩回教堂多刷几遍三祭司，多装几个紫骨片在包里（金色合成概率10%是人？），顺带用积木城堡养六个员工去图三（要带硬骨头的）攒一背包五六级治疗药水，然后两个晚上跑完一张图。 这样玩开心吗？我不知道。但至少应该不会像我一样破防。 是的。我破防了。你赢了。

I can't say I’d recommend this game right now. Everything feels painfully hard and overly punishing, even though I am a big fan of Souls-like games. I’m also not a fan of the bartering mechanic. It feels like you are just rolling dice, and there aren’t enough ways to actually make the system fun or enjoyable. As other players have mentioned, the economy is frustrating. You have to save a massive amount of money for your mortgage, collect specific quest items that you aren't allowed to sell, and spend gold to upgrade your skills. Since everything requires money, you are always broke. This makes you hesitant to spend anything on helpful QoL upgrades. This wouldn't be so bad if the game weren't so unforgiving when navigating dungeons. For me, most deaths happen because I miss a platform and lose over half my health to fall damage. Then, I usually die to a terrain obstacle immediately after. When you die, you lose most of your backpack. At that point, you might as well just reload your save. You can’t finish your quests or pay your mortgage if you keep dying, so you end up repeating the same 15-minute run over again. The stealth mechanics have some issues too. Without specific beetle upgrades, you're pretty much forced to make noise near a bush, wait for an enemy to get close, and then steal from them. It becomes repetitive and boring quickly. Sometimes there are neat puzzles where you lure enemies into spike traps, but then you’re back to worrying about fall damage while attempting it. The platforming feels okay, but there are too many long drops where a tiny mistake costs you half your health. I know the developers said they significantly reduced the mortgage payments, but it didn't seem to change for me. I might have needed to restart my save to see it. If that fix works, it might solve some of my issues. I think the game needs a bit of an overhaul for me to enjoy it. Here are my suggestions, ranked from most to least important: Greatly reduce fall damage. I think you can unlock a parachute with ~600 gold, but having to deal with that much damage early on is just frustrating. Add brief damage immunity. If I take a big fall or get hit by a trap, give me three seconds of immunity so I don't get hit by something else immediately and die instantly. Rework the bartering. The penalty for losing a trade should be lower. I would prefer a system more like "No Umbrellas Allowed," or honestly, I'd almost prefer if the bartering mechanic was removed entirely. Change how upgrades work. Players should unlock ability upgrades by completing quests rather than spending gold. The game has a lot of potential, and I'll keep an eye on it to see if things change. I would be happy to play it again in the future, but in its current state, it’s just not for me. (Just as a side note I really disliked the shop music, I think I turned it off on the 3rd day as it just did not fit the kind of music I want to hear for that long of a time on loop. A radio or record player that a player could change the music on would be fantastic.

这游戏不适合90%的人。 先说劝退的部分：难，是真的难。死亡有惩罚，背包会掉东西，没有实时存档，贪多了一把全没。节奏也不快，你得花时间观察敌人的巡逻路线，等空档，算时机，急性子会很痛苦。前几个小时你会反复在"偷到好东西"和"贪多死掉全丢了"之间来回横跳，挫败感很强。 但为什么我玩了三十多个小时停不下来？ 因为这游戏的爽点就建立在这个"难"上面。背包快满了，血只剩一格，前面还有一个宝箱。偷不偷？偷了可能死，不偷又不甘心。你咬咬牙上了，成功摸出来的那一刻，肾上腺素直接拉满。卖货也是，两倍已经赚了，骰子再赌一把可能三倍，也可能被压到0.6。你知道该收手，但手就是控制不住。 这就是这游戏最毒的地方：它让你真的体验到什么叫"贪婪"。不是剧情告诉你贪婪，是你自己玩着玩着就贪了，然后为贪婪付出代价，然后下一把继续贪。明知道会翻车，但那个"万一成了呢"的念头让你根本停不下来。 所以说，这游戏确实不适合所有人。但如果你吃这口，它会比大部分游戏都上头。

I really enjoy this game, it's hard in just the right way. Like flappy bird, you always want to try one more time when you fail. However, it is difficult to recommend this game because of a game breaking bug that makes your entire backpack disappear when you die. It seems to be persistent once it begins, meaning that for the rest of your game you must never die or always lose 100% of the things you picked up every run. I have the item that increases your death backpack size, and this bug seems to only occur once you reach Goldenville. Until this bug is fixed, the game is completely unbalanced and near unplayable. If you have any important items needed for quests when this happens, they are permanently lost, too. So until this is fixed I cannot recommend it because this bug is too severe and will make people quit playing the game for good once they reach this stage of the game. Otherwise, I enjoy the theme and characters. The gameplay loop is solid and I like both the shopkeeping and the thieving parts as-is. There is potential for something great here, the game really appeals to me as a fan of the Styx series and other iconic stealth games like Sly.

[b]以下是目前体验了三个小时的感觉，这个游戏有创意但是毁在制作组根本不好好玩同类型游戏上吸收经验且对于金钱的贪婪和懒惰等罪行造成游戏不伦不类，莫名其妙。以下将我体验的感知到的游戏体验汇总为千字长评。如果你很想入手这款游戏，又不知道这款游戏到底素质如何，你可以借助这篇测评决定是否入手。[/b] [u] 1.以正式版上架却还不如很多EA的贪婪之罪[/u] 这个游戏2026年5月1日上架，截至同年5月6日。就产生了各种BUG，包括我入手三分钟就遇到的死亡后背包物品全部消失。还有入手十分钟就出现的任何操作无法进行。看似避免了国产游戏的EA上架诈骗，然而这个正式版某种意义上就是标注为“正式版”其实际就是“EA”的事实。想要追求财富的心可以理解，但是游戏素质无法理解，只能理解为对于想要挤进游戏市场赚快钱的那份贪婪让这种素质的游戏匆匆上架。 [u] 2.根本不玩同类型经典之作的懒惰之罪 [/u] 这款游戏主要美术和玩法某种意义上就是横向卷轴2D像素游戏。不管缝合了多少小游戏机制，总体来说就是一种“银河城”。而所谓的“搜打撤”既然作为游戏主要玩法。那么其最重要的核心也就是“动作”这个关键就要仔细打磨。但该制作组抬上来的是什么？是一个跳跃僵硬，游戏镜头古怪，操作蹩脚的怪胎游戏。举个例子，玩家操作的主角哥布林维克，在游戏中有很多的上下梯子的过程，在梯子上上下的时候，竟然不能使用跳跃直接从架梯上跳下。这种在2D卷轴动作游戏中非常常见的机制竟然没有。你所操纵的这个绿色小人竟然只能爬到顶或者从爬到底才能移动。这种FC时代的动作逻辑是如何运用在一个2026年的游戏里的啊？简直不可思议！就算照抄“银河城”中任何一款经典作品都不会做的如此蹩脚。 [u] 3.什么都想缝且什么都缝不好的傲慢之罪 [/u] 游戏的底子确实还行，但是在游戏流程设计的规划上问题点就太多了。作为游戏策划，列一下我觉得有问题的点吧，希望后期你们可以优化掉。 1.最大的问题点，地图流程中可撤离点过少，同时缺少一个直接撤离道具。你看玩家反馈一大堆的难度毛病，其实归结起来就是一点，你第三张矿坑开始的图，撤离点拉的太远了。你游戏本身陷阱设计的多，角色性能差，这都没什么太大问题。但是撤离点拉的太远，导致玩家在开荒时很艰难的过掉一段初见陷阱流程，这时候残血了，正常应该是取舍是否要撤离。但是撤离点过远又没有可以主动撤离的道具，那就只能继续开荒探路，一旦再次碰到初见杀陷阱，玩家是不会觉得是他自己贪了，只会是觉得开发者在针对他。 2.搜这点做的不够好，搜的爽点是什么你要弄清楚，你摸出来的东西都是1*4或者2*2，价格全部都是一个等级一个价，那么摸到东西就会缺少惊喜感，不同种类的东西价格一定要不同，甚至可以多弄点不同形状的。这样为了填背包才会选择要不要再贪了去摸一下别的怪凑满包。不同地图上的怪一定要设计出不同的稀有道具大奖，这样玩家才会在搜的过程中有多次探同一个图的动力。 3.经营模式融的不行，因为物品需求只按种类走，物品价格又过于统一，导致经营的时候玩家感觉不是把符合客人需求的东西卖出去，而是该爆点爆点该拒绝拒绝，最后找一个简单难度冤大头把一波货物全吃了。 4.支线进度问题，支线触发的进度间隔太短，同时你的支线没有做进度锁，我这边打的时候因为进度较快，刚到矿坑的时候血精灵就找我进银行了。然而我试着进了一下银行，发现银行这块的难度根本就不是按黄金村的下一个来的，估摸按照你的那个地图排序应该是正常要我通了矿坑后才适合去打的。那正常没理解你这难度设计的玩家会如何？如果他头铁直接跳过矿坑在这个进度上去开荒银行，30血的小身板，只点了前两行技能，开3个护符，骨头会碎可能开荒的时候不带骨头，那你自己评估一下这样的属性对于银行难度来说合不合理？ 5.使用道具问题。药水有那么多种类，你为啥底下没有给个1234快捷键给一键设置喝的药呢？矿坑中了诅咒我得先开背包再进去找到药水右键选择喝药，这不对吧。还有那个诅咒爆炸发烟声响的道具，不应该设置成放怪包里面才生效的，而是应该复用铃铛虫逻辑用抛物线丢出去生效的。正常我都能摸到怪的包了，我不直接清完走人了，我还给他放东西再生效不是多此一举么？有占背包的这个功夫我可以直接选择把这个丢了多装点别的了。

One of those games I'd give a neutral to if I could. There is fun to be had. There is also frustration. Unlike the other negative reviews, I think the actual issue with the game (which other problems feed from) is the shop/selling system. By default, 4 customers come to your store each day, and will only purchase specific types of items (eg: swords, potions). Usually, all four customers will want virtually the exact same items, as there is a system that goes "tomorrow more people will want swords", which will mean that literally everyone wants swords. The actual mechanics of selling mean that you're best off selling everything you can to a single buyer to maximise profit. To limit how much gold you can make at a time, your backpack space for the rougelike dungeon crawling is very limited (again, by default, maybe it gets bigger later). So for the shop component, the game loop is effective: 1. Get told what item to prioritise in the dungeon 2. Exclusively fill your bag with that one item type 3. Run out of bag space with about 5 of the same item 4. Leave the dungeon 5. Sell all 5 items to the first person that walks in the door 6. Skip the rest of the customers because you're now out of that item and customers literally won't buy anything else. 7. Repeat. It weakens the dungeon experience because you're doing inventory management and just trying to get the same thing over and over. And you can't just ignore it and get the best stuff, because the debt system means you need to be maximising profit to progress with buying any personal upgrades. The debt payments are also way too often. Every 3-4 days or something. So if you die once, or want to spend a dungeon day doing something that isn't purely going after the thing that you know will be bought tomorrow, all of your money is going into paying your debt rather than buying skills etc. The dungeon crawlling is actually quite fun. The idea of stealing and needing to outrun or trick the NPCs into walking into traps is good. It's just that a metroidvania style game really lends itself to letting you die or explore. The way the shop works in this game and your debt absolutely do not lend itself to letting you die or explore freely.

从情感与潜力上很想给出好评以资鼓励，但站在玩家的角度，这个体验只能以差评论处。很遗憾Steam没有中评的选择，个人评分 6.5/10，勉强合格，潜力可期，静观后变。 谨记：游戏的任何设计与风味首先要能玩，其次要好玩，如此前提下才值得褒扬。 [hr][/hr] [h1] 并非“欠不起”而是“贪不起” [/h1] 高死亡惩罚的设计本身不算问题，问题在于过与严苛的惩罚与整体数值体系联动带来的噩梦般体验。首先，背包道具骨片提供了类似等级的成长体系：血量带来容错，速度提高操作难度但可以加快清图速度，幸运则影响至关重要的整局收益。就算其他成长全部解锁，没有骨片的“基础”游玩体验也是很不友好的。在成长强依赖避无可避的基础上，骨片获取少，合成概率低，失败没保底，死亡丢干净；这几条单独列举或一二组合还能算作某种风味，但四条兼备那就只能称为灾难了。这意味着：不利用各种手段修改作弊的“正常玩家”需要摸十数小时无聊的单调内容才能凑够舒适区间的属性数值，却在开图时一次失误死亡就几乎从零开始，这真的很酷么？如果角色死亡后等级重置回1级，简单难度与真实难度实际无异，贪婪的初始一百幸运使上手反而更易有如简单，简直是倒反天罡。 在骨片升级机制带来高昂的死亡惩罚外，本应存在的“保障性”兜底机制又完全缺位。角色仓库的大小与游玩阶段的需求并不匹配，到通关真结局都未必能解锁的最后一档临时增益却只对中期的能力水平存在价值，商店售卖很难转换为成本投入使销售玩法与探索出现割裂，背包大小的限制只够搜集商品，很难兼顾开荒探索与诅咒物品的需要。这种种联携又进一步放大了死亡惩罚的恶性体验。私以为这种积极开荒的“贪玩家”会因为搜刮到大量重要物品进不到足量货物，才是之前“欠不起”体验的因由。能力解锁使操作可以更激进却由于极易暴毙的后果让不多的玩法趣味更添折磨。当贪一把的目的从以小博大变成不想再跑一遍，一切的性质就彻底变了 从整体体验来看，个人认为游戏实质上只提供了“不能死”的选项，当贪的惩罚被放大到无穷，失败后唯一选择便只有回档。一种能带来合理体验的“要不要贪一把”，应该是“贪赢了大赚一笔，贪输了东山再起”而不是目前的“贪赢了没赚多点，贪输了一蹶不振”。试想成败的差距若非数倍而是几个数量级，这哪叫风险权衡，这只能是威逼利诱：反正都白干，不回档跟回档有区别么？有的，不回档等于删档呢亲。这种情况下再怎么限制存档，哪怕改成回档一周，那都是回档更划算。玩家对实时存档的呼声，本质是对死亡惩罚的极度不满，潜台词是：如果你们坚持这样的死亡惩罚，起码多给些存档的局外手段兜底，才能让人勉强玩的下去。对单机来说，在这种地方盲目坚持消极应对是愚蠢的，不让存档，玩家还可以改存档，可以风灵月影，乃至可以差评退款，网游手游更是如此操作的都暴死了基本活不过一个月。但凡能正常爽玩，谁会想SL呢？无脑SL只会损伤自己的体验罢了。 总之，前期死得起，但是死了白干不如重开；中期勉强死得起，但是死的憋屈没赚倒赔依旧重开，后期死不起，死了进度倒退十天只能重开。开图探索体验好，但是背包塞的全是重要物品，不给赚；摸金重复略无聊，但是开店卖货解锁成长被迫一直跑，不给爽。这并非是玩家吐槽的个别点上的问题，更像是整体设计的败笔。这使得有限利用良性bug或局外手段作弊修改后的体验反而更佳，流程连贯一气呵成，只能说令人遗憾了。 [h1] 匮乏的重复内容与背道而驰的激励体系 [/h1] 游戏总共提供了4张地图，对初见来说开荒本身能支撑大概15小时无垃圾时间的游玩体验。但经营的部分实际要求玩家反复探索之前的部分来积攒货品，由此来看现有的内容就有些单薄或者说缺乏变化了，哪怕多个三五种敌怪机关，组合一下多加点分支小图也能多出不少变化，体验都会好很多。就现实而言考虑小作坊毕竟产能有限，表示遗憾但可以理解。 同样，目前游戏的店铺经营玩法其实也略显单调，跟开荒探图的部分有些割裂，这部分也是可以深挖增加内容的，但如果说经营的卖作为分支本就不想投入太多侧重，或者说产能不足以丰富这部分的内容的话，也都是可以理解的 虽说如此，但值得注意的是，内容不够丰富会事实上放大高昂死亡惩罚的腻烦性体验。简单类比：在主线内容只有10小时的情况下，现在重新凑一背包金骨头东山再起就相当于“二周目”从头跑一遍整个主线。此外，内容不够丰富也会降低玩家重复摸宝的欲望，事实上，当整体通关后，重跑解锁不同结局成就收尾时，游戏体验就毫无期待感，只剩下机械性的“我要打完”了。顺便一提，从这个角度看结局的分歧点的安排与结局通关后回溯的机制也显得很不聪明。 谨记，如果在内容量的定位是“小品级”，那在其他地方的体验就需要更高的追求，而有风险的风味设计，更是需要诸多手段平衡内容补充才能保证整体的体验 [h1] 还需打磨的细节 [/h1] 虽然细节问题或者这种恶性bug并不少，好在刚发行两周已经连打了20多个补丁去修补，这一点目前看诚意倒还是足够的。 以下是个人建议的简单列举： 默认键位设定需要优化：shift 天天蹦粘滞键，alt真的很难找，鼠标中键右键不能设定，不能组合键，尽管有的功能按键实质并不冲突也不能一键多用（比如潜伏/下移动/开伞都可以用同一个下键）虽然能自改这点很机智，但如果默认能更合理一点，不是更好么？ 此外，像是藏品加成数值的查看（尤其是能跨天累积的那种），整理货品时锁定特定不想卖货品位置（如预留给订单的，如特殊的任务道具），物品（尤其升级和缩小油脂）的批量使用，背包1x2与两个1x1物品允许位置对换，进图时允许保留一套默认的物资选择方案等等，这种种功能的缺失其实是会极大影响体验的 雇员和加盟商的升级时产生效果的选项，在满级后只会白白占位置，不如改成满级后变为负面特性，这样就能被预定订单的随机效果消除。尤其招募满级加盟商一看全是这种词条，比全是红色负面还恶心，根本对不上它正面词条的属性 物品，敌怪，机关，雇员词条，加盟商词条，这些信息如果有图鉴来进行查阅会更好（这种信息补充也能起到一定的教程作用） 顺便，壁画关不能查看地图是个不错的设计，但如果通关（拿到目标物品）后能够解锁，答完卷子让玩家能看眼答案，体验似乎也会更好些 达成单次成交记录时，记录进度条走的非常慢，从10w到30w要干等超过1分钟 黄金村升降梯下方的解密，如果卡了个时间差被压到下面，没有路回到地表，有可能死不掉回不去导致实质性死档 装死偷窃成功后动画演出存在问题，仍在装死状态下的维克会显示为站立但不能移动（顺便建议装死后左右键可以取消装死直接移动，减少无效交互步骤会使手感更顺畅） [hr][/hr] [h1] 胡言乱语之：如我去改 [/h1] 观前叠甲：以下皆一家之言，且很多调整可能不适合同时加入 按照当前的内容量（综合地图复杂度、机关敌怪种类，事件任务长度），我认为在作为基准的“一般（对应鲁莽）”难度下，以25小时左右通关，35小时以内全收集是一个比较健康的设计标的，就算考虑贪失败重试的部分，也不应高于50小时。体感超出20小时的部分就开始感觉内容越发重复，或者说越发无趣。如果能够增加一倍的地图大小（不需要新的主题，只是更多的平铺展开），十种左右的机关与敌怪，这个标线可以从20小时拉高到30，就收益来说其实比较推荐，但考虑现实工作量，就算放弃这种方案也可以理解。 从设计上，这种时长可以作为各种数值调整的参考基准。由此死亡一次的惩罚性风险应该严格限制在1小时最好是半小时的投入以内，也就意味着绝不应一次长关卡探索后除了解锁近路几乎没有收益（尤其前期，后期由于雇员存在保底反而提高了，不考虑骨片的问题其实死了也就死了反而相对更容易接受）。个人认为，按照初期摸索机制贪一把可以开图失败了穷光蛋亏了也就亏了，中期有一定保底贪一把可以有高收获失败了有保险起码不会跌落水平线，后期保持现有感觉，稳定爽打同时特殊主线关卡收尾结局的思路来做数值，是相对较合理的 高风险高收益的设计思路可以，赌感的设计也可以，但这一切风味能好玩的前提是合理的数值设计。谨记数据之外玩家投入的时间与情感才是最大的成本，如果赌一次的风险是数十小时的积累化为乌有，[u] 这并不叫坚持，这只能叫愚蠢 [/u] [b] 修改部分过于随机的设计 [/b] 骨片升级失败时，从碎裂成垃圾，改成碎裂成骨粉，骨粉可以用来给骨头附魔来提供各种强化效果，比如增加下一次成功的概率或者保护不会碎裂或者提供基础属性特效。 真随机可以是一种设计思路，但它需要刷子游戏的大量出货来支撑才会有趣，当前骨片和诅咒的产出数量属实难以支撑。用最基础的概率期望估算，哪怕是通关后的终盘阶段，想正常赌出一个特定种类的金骨头需要多少小时？如果正常途径让玩家在屏幕前机械性操作数小时来刷一个金骨头，那是在游戏还是在上工？ 诅咒护符也存在类似的问题，收益与成本（风险也是一种成本）并不对等。按照现在的数值，正常玩家到全收集也就能做不到10个诅咒护符，在这样的产出预期下，还让玩家去搏一搏？这也不叫随机，这是欺诈 [b] 减轻死亡时骨片的惩罚 [/b] 将死亡时直接全碎改成两次才碎，或者从碎成垃圾改成允许花费代价修复，或者将必定全碎改成概率碎一定数量，或者可以花钱赎回（不建议咬人箱子，为了它单独跑一天，在目前的游戏体量下节奏显得比较拖沓，这与重要道具的顺路拿回并不相同），或者在增益购买保护或者增加替代惩罚的特殊道具，或者几种结合着来。重点在于提供弥补手段而非一键清零，约束失败的代价，才能让玩家起码有的选 [b] 提高便利性与难度自选 [/b] 增加进入地图时和开始卖货时两个自动存档点，在地图的撤退选择外添加一个类似战棋的临时中断的特殊存档点 实时存档不符合设计风味是个合理的理由，但无论如何玩家临时离开的最基本的现实需求不当被无视，尤其是考虑到谨慎行动时一次探图可能持续1小时以上。在这个预期下，哪怕不允许无限制的存档，也必须提供某种相关的便利。在游戏要求高风险博弈时，SL重开将事实上成为一种保底的机制成为玩法的一部分，那么对这种操作的便利性支持也就应该纳入考量。 现有的部分机制或者设计风味，如果想一定程度保留，可以考虑调整为高难度乃至真实难度下的追加特性或者自选特性。比如骨片死亡全碎这种设计，如果真的想留下，也只适合作为特殊的挑战选项，而不是给所有人的默认选择（事实上我认为死亡删档的真实模式反而是不必要的，死亡时删光骨片已经是到死亡删档的体验感了，如果觉得不够再加上消耗存款的一半来复活就是了，直接删存档对一个主旨为“要不要贪一把”的游戏来说，属实有点奇怪了。没有趣味体验的模式并无意义，当前的种种坚持就颇有种过犹不及的感觉） [b] 增强“进货”时重复游玩的体验 [/b] 在地图中增加不在主要路线上的一些（可以考虑少量随机变化的）分支地图，添加类似图1的BOSS、瞎子，钥匙看守这种相对当前地图更难的怪（哪怕只有个位数种类），提供少量下一图水准的物品。 添加更多只有偷（特殊敌人）能获取，或随机刷新地图的看守宝箱而非小弟量产的珍宝道具。为新的珍宝道具添加销售时类似藏品的一次性效果 [b] 增加保底性质的图内收益 [/b] 给冒险者添加可以把东西带回去的信使功能（可以考虑数值给的很低，但应该有，这可以让重要道具是负累但不会无限度惩罚开荒收益。尤其地图内容较少时，开近路后摸金的重复内容会光速消耗游戏体验，开荒的直接收获因此应得到更多激励），或者在图里售卖的随机事件，或者银行服务以特定税率兑换钱袋。 这种功能的意义在于优化前期尤其是开图时的体验，让生手更容易上手而非轻易劝退，也能缓解背包大小限制产生的特定体验问题。 [b] 为角色提供更多“基本”数值 [/b] 临时增益可以用双倍价格购买第二项，三个等级的增益可以同时选但低级增益效果减半且不能与第一个增益种类相同（以更多成本投入博取更高收益也是种贪的风味，而且现有的增益基本只值得无脑选实在太缺了的背包格子，有点形同虚设了） 用保险（减弱死亡惩罚）替换掉临时增益中没啥意义的药水油脂的消耗性道具选项（增益应该提供更不可替代的独特选项） 类似面具能力第三分支提供永久幸运加值，为其他升级添加负重（背包格子）、血量，速度的永久加成（可以少给但不能不给，尤其不能假定所有玩家都是不到1%的高手，或带着一种某类玩家与狗不得游玩式的傲慢。这种局外成长，本身是保障中期游戏体验非常好用的简单方案）。 将护符里显著影响探图流程，实质上必定常驻携带的几个选项，比如勾爪长度加倍，三段跳，改成以某种方式后期解锁的永久性增益（在内容不够丰富的情况下，为了一个小小的收集重复打一整关，并不是一个合适的设计思路，这种需要装配的设计，如果地图内容增加10倍，以那种探索新地图为主的横版闯关玩法作主导，才更显合理） [b] 店铺增加更多成长 [/b] 店铺等级5时可以多一次售卖更多提价次数 实习店员加入后可以招揽客户，提供一客人数量（作为完成支线的初始奖励） 其实目前售卖收益与游戏进度有点不匹配，各种藏品平衡也是有些问题的，但是这点并不好改，个人建议应当极度慎重。藏品的数值平衡其实是最烧脑的，做多反而容易错多，尤其现在版本各种地方都急需加强的情况下更不敢动刀削弱。目前来看只推荐把积木城堡和卷轴精通解锁的位置调换，前者在一图就解锁还是过于强势了，其过高的收益变相在初期就诱惑玩家使得彻底无法接受吹爆失败也并不合理。

Has one of the worst save systems known to gaming, but Stoneshard is still worse. Say you spend an hour clearing an entire dungeon, and you are under the impression that when you go home the game saves. The developer tells you the game saves at the beginning of every morning and evening, BUT! what it actually means is that it saves in the morning AFTER you complete the un-skippable NPC events. So, if you quit the game as soon as the morning starts, you lose the entire hour of dungeon crawling, along with the loot and progress. This is all done in the disgusting attempt by the developer to prevent you from cheating in their single player game. So, if you initially misunderstand their save system and decide you want to go grocery shopping to stay alive in real life, after an hour in the dungeon, the developer thinks you are cheating because you didn't talk to their NPCs before you logged out. Any game that the developer intentionally messes with the save system in order to prevent cheating, in a SINGLE PLAYER GAME, is an automatic negative review. Thanks for wasting my time.

Goblin Vyke is a game that I find myself quitting often but coming right back even in the same night. I find myself incredibly torn about this game. On one hand, the character arts at times give me an AI vibe, but I can't find any notes or comments about that being the case(the character, Dummy, especially) If someone corrected me that no AI was used and that artists have been utilized and paid, I would believe them. Just something about it- The English language dialogues at times are a bit jank or flow unnaturally. The seed values result in some sales being completely impossible to succeed on(you can tell with an ability that tells you your next 3 rolls. So if you see 6,5,5, there's really no avoiding a Bust) Getting used to the controls is taking some doing when it comes to menu navigation and non-freeform movement sequences, frequently using the trigger buttons to choose options, rather than a moveable selection of options. The fact that many of these menus have an "are you sure you want to proceed" screen has been annoying but nonetheless a lifesaver, because I frequently almost fire employees, reject customers, or enter the dungeon unprepared just by hitting RT instead of RB, when I would prefer a directional >-v-[Confirm] AND YET: The pixel graphics are charming, the animations are fluid(enemy jumps are a bit... eh), the characters follow enjoyable and iconic archetypes, the platforming is tight, the gameplay loop is sound, and each stage of the game, as frustrating as it can be at times, is overall fun. It reminds me a lot of Dave the Diver, in a way. It's really 2 games in one, phase 1 is collection, phase 2 is sales. The sales are RNG based represented by dice rolls, with a limited number of extra abilities to put your thumb on the scale. You get a heads up on what ranges to expect from customers, with temperaments of Easy, Average, and Hard having broader target numbers or more narrow. The collection is high skill expression that rewards patience pattern recognition, and timing above fast reaction speed, but there is room for a panic flailing from time to time as well. I really cannot stress enough how much I enjoy this game's aesthetic. The music is also pretty good, doesn't feel oppressively repetitive. I do suspect that as your character upgrades more(specifically speed and health), the game may reach a point of no return where stealth is no longer necessary and that you can just sprint past every obstacle. I've only just reached the second map area and already feel that sneaking past enemies is borderline optional. Whether that's a good thing or not is hard to say. Having to stealth through EVERY enemy on EVERY run would be tedious, but getting to just ignore and skip past anyone removes a lot of the stakes as well. It's a tough balance to find. TLDR; I'm surprised this game has Mostly Positive reviews(despite giving a Recommend review myself) just because there are so many opportunities for someone to say "This isn't for me". But I keep coming back to it despite my frustrations because at its core the game IS charming and fun.

I like this game but there is too many flaws so I cannot recommend it to others. First of all, the save system is too frustrating. You cannot save anytime you want (like just before going to the dungeon when you just have bought every upgrade you deemed necessary and with your backback fully ready). So each time you reload the game, you have to redo everything. I can understand that you cannot save inside dungeons, but, at least, let us save anytime we want during the shop management. Secondly, there is, at least, one moment of the game that you can miss (like, after a certain event, you MUST go in that exact location the day after. If you don't, you will miss a key item for one of the endings. Who enjoys that ? Where is the justification of that ? Moreover, there is no hint at all that you missed it but you KNOW that you're missing something (like, you need a key to unlock a door but you don't know where to find it). These are, for me, the two main flaws I see in this game. There are some other minor ones like : - The farting dash. Ok, we make noise when we're dashing but are we 8 years old ? - The repetitiveness of the merchant part of the game. The mini-game is fun at the beginning and trying to optimize our sales is somewhat ok, but after 20 days, there should be some other mechanisms to use. (See Dave the Diver, for instance, the day minigames evolve during the story) - Some of the dungeon/enemy's mechanisms aren't that clear. As an exemple, we don't have many clues to know what an enemy's aura will do. Dungeon's puzzles can sometimes be frustrating because of that (I ended up bruteforcing one of them, lacking the understanding of what the developpers meant). - Controls are somewhat clunky from time to time. - Only 4 dungeons... But, there are some good things too (I played this game for 30 hours...) : - The concept is quite enjoyable (merchants by day, thief by night) - The merchant minigame is fun (at the beginning...) - The thief part is quite good - The story is not bad and not too present - Dungeons are not badly designed for the most part So, not a bad game, but you really have some debatable choice in terms of gameplay. Buy it knowing that.
